_comment: Config for macro-regime-read SKILL.md Section 3b factor grouping. Consumed by scripts/regime_score.py. Edit weights HERE, not in SKILL.md, so there is one source of truth.
_provenance_WARNING: These weights are JUDGMENT, not empirically derived. Unlike the Section 3a
threshold bands -- which are computed from FRED history and can be
regenerated by scripts/walcl_regime_bands.py -- nothing here was fitted,
backtested, or validated against realised outcomes. They encode a prior
about which factors dominate at which horizon. Committing them to a repo
makes them versioned and inspectable. It does not make them correct.
Treat any change to these numbers as an argument to be made explicitly,
and run the sensitivity analysis before assuming a change matters.

scoring_scale._gap_rule: Genuine data gaps are EXCLUDED from the factor average, never scored 0. A missing signal is not a neutral signal.

caps._comment: Maximum relative adjustment to the base rate, by horizon.

base_rates._comment: SPX historical frequency of a drawdown beginning within the horizon. Correction = 10-19.9%, Crash = 20%+. Approximate; not recomputed from source. FLAGGED as the weakest empirical link in the whole framework.

factor_weights._comment: Each horizon column must sum to 1.00. Validated at load time.

factor_rows._comment: Which matrix rows roll into each factor. Reference only; the script does not parse this.

adjustment_rule._comment: S = sum(factor_score * horizon_weight). Clamp S to [-1, +1]. adjustment = clamp(S) * cap. final = base * (1 + adjustment).
